svg.title: personal-computer in a terminal
svg.desc: Real output: /personal-computer check reports the models, the scanner and the private agent ok. Then Claude is asked what was spent on groceries in October: the statement it lists is withheld for its name, address and IBAN, Claude hands the task to anymodel:qwen, and answers 322.90 euros.
